name: checksum
description: A minimal, evidence-driven design, plan, execute, and finish workflow with diagnosis for unexplained failures. Upfront design and fresh verification carry the quality load; testing policy is spec-anchored by default and configurable per project.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose when needed; design, plan, execute, and finish with evidence.
interface.longDescription: A minimal development workflow for coding agents. Diagnose unexplained failures before fixing, design and plan before code, execute against spec-anchored acceptance checks, and finish only with fresh verification evidence. Configurable per project through a plain-markdown preferences file.
defaultPrompt: Use checksum to design and build a new feature.
Diagnose and fix this failure with checksum.
Resume the checksum plan in this repo.
